title: Nonhuman micro details: complete palette, real settlement and bounded presentation
head: b6678ea9ba4a7cf0313ce83e0c0fc6b0e5c26d5b

reviews.classification: Full original texture/result palette; actual consequence and anti-duplication scope qualified
reviews.disposition:
F1. Complete review covers all 120 body details, MD-S1–S8, MD-B1–B8, MD-E1–E6, MD-L1–L6, MD-C1–C6, MD-N1–N10 and MD-P1–P5. Preserve the useful split between describing an existing fact and changing it: the eleven body-result rows and cross-cutting result rows need actual placement/access/custody/policy/learning/effect settlement. A caption cannot unlock a locked Shack, allocate a dish, transfer stock, dry a condition, teach a method, pay an escort twice or discover unseen identity. Body-result counts are not the total count of proposed consequential rows across the entire document.

F2. Text-only does not mean free invention. Repeated witness behavior needs an actual counterpart and received history; stored fittings, repair marks, garments, cover and support fixtures need their declared facts. Ambient animal chatter is not a simulated named animal or inherited encounter history. Rat and bird variants do not combine anatomy; guide quiet mode does not invent a sleeping body; a guest cannot feel its old shell without a remaining channel. Missing meaningful state supports omission or qualified neutral prose. Actual source-supported exceptions can supply unusual senses, regeneration, production, shared awareness or complete faculties rather than being prohibited by these examples.

F3. Read the no-farm wording through AD22/AD38: a cosmetic line does not mint output or duplicate settlement, but real repeated shedding, growing, teaching, work, care or renewable ecology can produce useful gains where the mechanism and available means support them. Preserve fractional practice, beneficial routine and source-specific powerful starts. A finite original offcut offer is not a universal ban on replenished gifts or production; exact actor/stock/job/clock terms decide the next offer. Mere kindness creates no hidden debt, and borrower obligations depend on the actual consumable/return terms. Actual skin/material and condition rules decide wetness or wear, not a category label or a mandatory comfort tax.

F4. Eligibility, stable cosmetic wording and bounded recent-key suppression remain separate from consequence identity and retained skills/promises/stock. Cosmetic cache pruning cannot reset unique settlement. MD-N1's ten/three-minute ceilings, four recent IDs, daily cadence and two return highlights are tunable estimates, not measured universal gates. Texture settings do not consume gameplay draws or change mechanics. ACR activity compression can reduce repeated prose while preserving useful outcomes and decision boundaries; quiet/plain modes keep necessary results, blockers, commands and return. Rich mode adds text rather than claiming a more faithful simulation. Current clock/continuation owners qualify the historical closed-browser-freeze sentence; no caption advances work or weather.

F5. The first-milestone sentence and 1366-primary viewport are superseded. Apply current desktop prose-first, independent panes and optional art with the selected body/observer context. MD-P1 explicitly supports small derived lines for an already admitted body without new-start admission; a full new-body engine, dedicated texture settings, durable preferences or rich ecology is not a prerequisite for that bounded prose case. Human taste remains optional under AD42, and these proposals remain proposals under AD32. A1–A8 and Paradise summaries retain historical read/translation limits; no linked primary text, code, UI accessibility, performance, native start, save round-trip or offline behavior was freshly verified here.
reviews.evidence: All 380 input lines delivered in ranges 1–140,141–280,281–380; no linked runtime, dossier or primary source review renewed.
reviews.reopen: Actual selected texture/result consumer, changed source/observer/body or persistence/continuation semantics. Keep harmless text-only scope small and consequential operations in their existing owners.
